import subprocess, sys, importlib

# Reload semver to ensure fresh state
import importlib
import semver
importlib.reload(semver)

print("=== FINAL VERIFICATION ===\n")

# R1: pysemver without arguments -> SystemExit(2)
result = subprocess.run(['pysemver'], capture_output=True, text=True)
r1_no_args = result.returncode == 2
print(f"[R1] pysemver no args -> exit={result.returncode} (expect 2): {'PASS' if r1_no_args else 'FAIL'}")

# R1: bump subcommand without specific args -> help text, exit 0
result = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'bump'], capture_output=True, text=True)
r1_bump_help = result.returncode == 0 and 'usage' in result.stdout.lower()
print(f"[R1] pysemver bump -> exit={result.returncode}, has help: {'PASS' if r1_bump_help else 'FAIL'}")

# R2: _REGEX compliance with semver.org (zero-prefix rejection)
isvalid = semver.VersionInfo.isvalid
assert isvalid('1.2.3') == True, "Valid version should pass"
assert isvalid('01.2.3') == False, "Zero-prefixed major should fail"
assert isvalid('1.02.3') == False, "Zero-prefixed minor should fail"
assert isvalid('1.2.03') == False, "Zero-prefixed patch should fail"
assert isvalid('1.2') == False, "Incomplete version should fail"
assert isvalid('') == False, "Empty string should fail"
assert isvalid('not a version') == False, "Invalid string should fail"
assert isvalid('1.2.3-alpha+build.123') == True, "With prerelease and build should pass"
r2_pass = True
print(f"[R2] Regex alignment with semver.org: PASS")

# R3: VersionInfo.isvalid + check subcommand
assert hasattr(semver.VersionInfo, 'isvalid'), "Missing isvalid"
assert callable(getattr(semver.VersionInfo, 'isvalid')), "isvalid not callable"
assert isinstance(isvalid('1.2.3'), bool), "isvalid must return bool"
result = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'check', '1.2.3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
r3_check_valid = result.stdout.strip() == 'True'
result = subprocess.run(['pysemver', 'check', 'invalid'], capture_output=True, text=True)
r3_check_invalid = result.stdout.strip() == 'False'
r3_pass = r3_check_valid and r3_check_invalid
print(f"[R3] VersionInfo.isvalid + check subcommand: {'PASS' if r3_pass else 'FAIL'}")

# R4: Public API exposure
for name in ['cmd_bump', 'cmd_check', 'cmd_compare']:
    assert hasattr(semver, name), f"Missing {name}"
    assert callable(getattr(semver, name)), f"{name} not callable"
for name in ['createparser', 'finalize_version', 'process']:
    assert hasattr(semver, name), f"Missing {name}"
    assert callable(getattr(semver, name)), f"{name} not callable"

# Verify they work
r = semver.cmd_bump('1.2.3', 'major')
assert r == '2.0.0', f"cmd_bump failed: {r}"
r = semver.cmd_check('1.2.3')
assert r == True, f"cmd_check failed: {r}"
r = semver.cmd_compare('1.2.3', '2.0.0')
assert r == -1, f"cmd_compare failed: {r}"
p = semver.createparser()
assert p is not None, "createparser failed"
r = semver.finalize_version({'version': '1.2.3'})
assert r == '1.2.3', f"finalize_version failed: {r}"
r = semver.process(type('Args', (), {'which': 'compare', 'left': '1.2.3', 'right': '2.0.0'})())
assert r == '-1', f"process failed: {r}"
r4_pass = True
print(f"[R4] Public API (cmd_bump, cmd_check, cmd_compare, createparser, finalize_version, process): PASS")

# Existing tests still pass
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'test_semver.py', '-q'], capture_output=True, text=True)
test_pass = result.returncode == 0
print(f"\n[Tests] Existing test suite: {'PASS' if test_pass else 'FAIL'} ({result.stdout.strip()})")

all_pass = r1_no_args and r1_bump_help and r2_pass and r3_pass and r4_pass and test_pass
print(f"\n{'='*40}")
print(f"ALL REQUIREMENTS MET: {'YES' if all_pass else 'NO'}")
